test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Blossom shower is common in________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blossom shower **is a natural phenomenon that occurs during the spring season.
 
• **Kerala is known for its beautiful blossom shower where the hills and valleys are covered with pink and white flowers.**
 
• The flowering season in Kerala generally **starts in February and lasts till April.**
 
• During this time, tourists from all over the world visit Kerala to witness the beauty of nature.
 
• West Bengal, Assam, and Uttar Pradesh also witness blossom showers but not as prominently as Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• West Bengal is known for its beautiful tea gardens and the best time to visit is during the monsoon season.
 
• Assam is known for its wildlife and tea plantations. The best time to visit is during the winter season.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is famous for the Taj Mahal and other historical monuments. The best time to visit is during the winter season

 
 

 **Name**
 **Important points**
 
 

 Blossom shower
 With this shower, coffee flowers blossom in Kerala and nearby areas.
 
 

 Nor-wester
 
 
These are dreaded evening thunderstorms in Bengal and Assam.

 
These showers are useful for tea, jute, and rice cultivation.

 
 
 

 Loo
 Hot, dry, and oppressing winds blowing in the northern plains from Punjab to Bihar with higher intensity between Delhi and Patna.
